warnings: THIS SHEET IS THE TARGET OF THE ก AND ข SECTION ARROWS drawn on A-04, A-05 and A-05's roof plan. Both callouts resolve here, so no dangling section reference remains in the set - unlike the แบบขยายรูปตัด ค leader on A-07, which resolves nowhere (flagged on that file).

SAME FIVE LEVELS AND THE SAME 2.55/3.10/3.40/0.60 CHAIN AS A-06 AND A-07, closing on +9.65 again. Three architectural sheets now agree on the ridge level against S-02's +10.00 note; see A-06's warning for the reading taken.
ROOF PITCH 35 DEGREES, printed on both sections.

*** LEVEL CONTRADICTION ON ซักล้าง, RESOLVED AS +0.40. *** This section prints ซักล้าง +0.50. A-03 (ผังบริเวณ) and A-04 (แปลนพื้นชั้นล่าง) both print ซักล้าง +0.40. Two sheets against one, and the two are the plans that set out the floor levels in the first place, so +0.40 is the reading; the +0.50 here is recorded verbatim on this element with a flag and a lowered confidence rather than corrected away. Note the neighbouring ห้องครัว is +0.50 on every sheet, which is the likely source of the slip.

THE SECTION LABELS ROOMS WITHOUT THEIR NUMBERS - it prints ห้องนอน twice and ห้องน้ำ once where the plans print ห้องนอน 1/2/3 and ห้องน้ำ 3. Ids here are made distinct by position (ห้องนอน_ซ้าย / ห้องนอน_ขวา) per §0.3's rule that two different members must never share one element_id, and flagged. They are NOT cross-linked to the plans' numbered rooms, because the section line's exact path was not resolved well enough to say which numbered bedroom each cut is.
รับประทานอาหาร ON THIS SECTION IS THE SAME ROOM THE PLANS CALL ทานอาหาร - a longer spelling of the same word, not a different room. Recorded as printed and flagged rather than renamed.
THE x CHAIN MATCHES THE MASTER: 1.00 eave + 3.50 + 2.20 + 3.00 + 1.00 eave under 8.70, bubbles 1-2-3-4 left to right (unlike A-07's mirrored elevations).

OPENING VOCABULARY RESOLVED ON A-14/A-15 (หน้า15, หน้า16). This file records no ป/น marks because the glyphs are unreadable at this scan's resolution. The schedules give the full closed list - eight door types ป1-ป8 and nine window types น1-น9, seventeen marks - so any later pass adding positions to this sheet has a fixed vocabulary to match against and cannot invent a mark. What is still missing is only WHICH type sits in WHICH opening on this drawing.
